source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: NntpClient reports the inclusive XOVER header count only for a nonempty valid range; otherwise it reports no new messages for the group. NewsDownloader reports an empty offline result before entering saveArticleOffline state, or one total article count before its sequential downloads. The fixed implementations route through MailServices.feedback; the downloader awaits Fluent while NntpClient formats synchronously. These are reporting/state boundaries, not proof that XOVER no longer blocks UI painting or every failed fetch is propagated. No NNTP task ran. The review asks for a new localization key when the value changes so localizers can track it, and Fluent for new strings. It requests async formatting where straightforward; the actual downloader adopts that while the protocol path remains synchronous.
title: NNTP header and offline-download status have different completion paths
